description:
Design & Implement all aspects at the platform level for hardware,software integrated engineered solutions. 
 This includes hardware,Virtualization,OS,Networking,Storage etc  
 The candidate must be excellent in scripting languages: JAVA is a must, Perl, Python etc 

 - University degree in Computer Science or related discipline 
 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills  
 - Experience with scripting languages/tools like Shell scripting, JAVA,Perl,Python,Tcl is required.  
 - Sound knowledge of Unix Networking - TCP/IP, Layer 2 (Switches,VLANs, Bonding, STP, LACP etc) is required.  
 - Sound knowledge of Linux/Solaris OS internals, automated install/setup, configuration, patching etc for enterprise applications  
 - Sound knowledge and programming experience on any Routers or Switches  
 - A good team player  

 Nice-to-have:   
 - Hands on experience with any server Cloud/virtualization technologies like Openstack, Xen (preferred),KVM,VMware  
 - Hands on experience with handling servers, storage, assembling/cabling of blade/rack mount servers  
 - Experience with SAN/NAS/DAS Storage using protocols like iSCSI,Infiniband,FC desired  
 - Experience with Oracle specific technologies/tools like Oracle Database, Enterprise Manager, Clusterware is  
 desirable  
 Note: This is a 6 month Contract-to-hire role and Client will provide sponsorship if required for qualified candidates.  

 - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". 
- All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply.
 - Most of our positions require Candidate to clear the Background check prior to commencing the assignment.
